title: AERON_flight_model_cooked texture extension
description: Written by aeron_gltf_cook, in cooked files only: the atlas page a texture uses. A cooked texture has no source of its own; KHR_texture_transform on the material's texture info places the texture within its page. Unknown fields are ignored.

source.title: Image
source.description: The image: a KTX2 array of atlas pages, in a buffer view, of the channel of the material slots that reference it.

layer.title: Page
layer.description: The page of the image the texture uses.

maxLod.title: Mip limit
maxLod.description: The mip levels the texture may sample: a texture packed on a shared page stops there, before its neighbours bleed into it. Without it, no limit.
